content: Euclidean/GCD visualizers (Zerethon, Toolexe, MathWorks) converge on: step-by-step (a,b)->(b,a mod b) table with each step highlighted, client-side no-dependency operation, and often a geometric/rectangle representation alongside the numeric table. Extended Euclidean variants add animated back-substitution to derive Bezout coefficients (gcd = s*a + t*b) and modular inverse computation.
